description: Experimental, opt-in (ENTIRE_GRAPH_PROMPT_CONTEXT=1): put the code graph's answer for the first prompt of a session into context, without a tool call.

hooks.command: case "${ENTIRE_GRAPH_PROMPT_CONTEXT:-}" in 1|true|TRUE|on|ON|yes|YES) command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/entire-graph-prompt-context.py";; esac; exit 0
